biomarkers.name: BAP1, MTAP / CDKN2A
biomarkers.prevalence: Alterations reported, but prevalence in pericardial mesothelioma is not well defined; often extrapolated from pleural mesothelioma

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Similar to pleural mesothelioma — epithelioid, sarcomatoid, or biphasic patterns
histomorphological_subtype.grading: No pericardial-specific grading system established; generally assessed using pleural mesothelioma principles

cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Mesoderm — from pericardial coelom (embryonic body cavity)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Mesothelial (calretinin+, WT1+); same lineage biology as pleural mesothelioma
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Same epithelioid → sarcomatoid progression as pleural/peritoneal mesothelioma
